svg.title: Get started with OmniRoute in four steps: Install, Start, Connect and get a key, Call /v1
svg.desc: Install with npm install -g omniroute, then run omniroute to start the dashboard and API on port 20128. Connect a provider from Dashboard → Providers and get a key from Dashboard → API Keys. Call http://localhost:20128/v1 with model auto. The four tiles fade in, dots travel the connectors, and the final border pulses.
svg.text: auto uses eligible connections; availability and provider limits still apply.
